description: Use when an agent must see how a page looks (layout, charts, visual QA, previews), not just its text. Input: url, width (320-1920, default 1280), full_page=1 for the whole page, format png or jpeg (default). Output: JSON imageBase64 (decode to the image), contentType, bytes, viewport. Renders JavaScript. Daily cap or bad URL refused before payment. Example: ?url=https://example.com/ Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

width.description: Viewport width in px (default 1280; height = 0.625 x width)

title: Web screenshot: render a page in headless Chrome and return the image
